mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO tbl_review_assign (pno, reviewer_id, assigned_date) VALUES (#{pno}, #{reviewerId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tbl_review_assign WHERE pno = #{pno} AND reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}
mapper.select: SELECT pno FROM tbl_review_assign WHERE reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_review (pno, reviewer_id, score_originality, score_feasibility, score_economy, score_impact, total_score, opinion, review_date) VALUES (#{pno}, #{reviewerId}, #{scoreOriginality}, #{scoreFeasibility}, #{scoreEconomy}, #{scoreImpact}, #{totalScore}, #{opinion}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score_originality = #{scoreOriginality}, score_feasibility = #{scoreFeasibility}, score_economy = #{scoreEconomy}, score_impact = #{scoreImpact}, total_score = #{totalScore}, opinion = #{opinion}, review_date = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT rno, pno, reviewer_id AS reviewerId, score_originality AS scoreOriginality, score_feasibility AS scoreFeasibility, score_economy AS scoreEconomy, score_impact AS scoreImpact, total_score AS totalScore, opinion, review_date AS reviewDate FROM tbl_review WHERE pno = #{pno} AND reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}

SELECT r.rno, r.pno, r.reviewer_id AS reviewerId, r.score_originality AS scoreOriginality, r.score_feasibility AS scoreFeasibility, r.score_economy AS scoreEconomy, r.score_impact AS scoreImpact, r.total_score AS totalScore, r.opinion, r.review_date AS reviewDate FROM tbl_review r WHERE r.pno = #{pno} ORDER BY r.review_date

SELECT r.rno, r.pno, r.reviewer_id AS reviewerId, r.total_score AS totalScore, r.review_date AS reviewDate, p.title AS proposalTitle FROM tbl_review r JOIN tbl_proposal p ON r.pno = p.pno WHERE r.reviewer_id = #{reviewerId} ORDER BY r.review_date DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_review WHERE pno = #{pno}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_review_assign WHERE pno = #{pno}
SELECT uid, uname FROM tbl_user WHERE role IN ('ROLE_REVIEWER', 'ROLE_ADMIN') AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY uname

SELECT r.rno, r.pno, r.reviewer_id AS reviewerId, r.score_originality AS scoreOriginality, r.score_feasibility AS scoreFeasibility, r.score_economy AS scoreEconomy, r.score_impact AS scoreImpact, r.total_score AS totalScore, r.opinion, r.review_date AS reviewDate, p.title AS proposalTitle FROM tbl_review r JOIN tbl_proposal p ON r.pno = p.pno ORDER BY r.pno, r.reviewer_id
